 Social Security payment schedule changed in November. What happened?
 Bonnie Bolden, Palm Beach Post 2026년 11월 10일 화 오후 3:41 UTC 0 Wondering when your Social Security payment will arrive this month? There are a few changes to the normal schedule, and some checks are coming early.
 Here's why the normal payment schedule is shifting: The Social Security Administration issues benefit payments on a set schedule, but holidays and weekends can cause changes. Then, people get paid on the last weekday before the normally scheduled date.
 Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments are affected more often because the standard payment date is the first of each month, which often falls on a weekend or banking holiday.
 Social Security benefits are typically disbursed to nearly 74 million people on specific Wednesdays, depending on their birth dates. Those payment days are less often affected by national holidays.
 This month, Veterans Day will cause a shift.
 Here’s what to know about the November payment schedule and where to find a Social Security office in Mississippi.
 When will I get my Social Security payment in November?
 Veterans Day is always on Nov. 11. That's a Wednesday this year, so the first round of regular payments will also be sent a day early. 
 If you normally get paid on the second Wednesday of the month, look for your payment on Tuesday, Nov. 10.
 When are Social Security payments in November 2026?
 The Social Security Administration’s  2026  payment schedules are online to help beneficiaries plan their budgets.
 Regular Social Security retirement benefits will be issued according to the SSA’s payment schedule in November:
 Tuesday, Nov. 10:  Birthdates between the first and 10th of the month
 Wednesday, Nov. 18:  Birthdates between the 11th and the 20th of the month
 Wednesday, Nov. 25:  Birthdates between the 21st and the 31st of the month
 ➤ Retirement savings gap hits seniors. How to avoid outliving your money 
 Why are there no SSI payments in November 2026?
 Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday, so SSI payments were issued on Friday, Oct. 30. It was the last weekday before the normal send date.
 No SSI checks will be issued in November because the next payment date falls on Dec. 1 as usual.
 Advertisement
 When is the next SSI payment in 2026?
 December payments will go out on the first as scheduled.
 The first check of the new year is always sent on New Year's Eve or the last weekday of the year because of the New Year's Day holiday.
 What is the SSI payment schedule for 2026?
 Supplemental Security Income checks will be sent out on the following dates in 2026, according to  the SSA calendar .
 They are usually sent on the first of the month but will be disbursed early if the first falls on a weekend or holiday.
 Tuesday, Dec. 1 (check for December)
 Thursday, Dec. 31 (check for January 2027)
 Why will some people get 3 Social Security payments in a month?
 People who get both SSI and regular Social Security benefits will be paid three times in December.
 The regular SSI payment comes on the first. The Social Security check gets paid on its usual date. Then the SSI funds for the following month are sent near the end of the month because the next SSI disbursement date falls on a weekend or holiday.
 See the full 2026 Social Security payment schedule
 This graphic shows all payment dates for SSI, Social Security and people who get both or were receiving Social Security before 1997.
 When will the 2027 COLA increase show up in Social Security checks?
 A 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment ( COLA ) means that the average benefit check of $2,087.52 will rise to $2,162.67 each month, according to AARP, a nonprofit, nonpartisan advocate for people aged 50 and older. That's an additional $75.15 per month, or $901.81 annually.
 It will start showing up in January payments.
 The first SSI checks to include the increase will be paid out on Dec. 31, 2026.
 Where are Social Security offices in South Florida?
 There are three Social Security offices in Palm Beach County and 15 in South Florida. To find the one nearest you, visit  ssa.gov/locator .
